issues.title: Subagent runs fail with 'model_coming_soon' on MiMo-V2.6-Flash while the main session on the same model works fine

en.headline: 12 commits across 2 repos, 1 issue comment on opencode subagent bug
en.summary: On 2026-10-17, the user made **12 commits** across two repositories. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, 10 own commits covered AI retry logic for empty content responses, summary rendering fixes including per-repo count pills and expanded `byRepo` limits, a CI rebase-retry for push failures, Chinese badge font sizing, a homepage teaser with per-repo statistics, a provider switch from `Zen` to `OpenCode Go`, and an `AGENTS.md` update. An additional 26 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` were recorded in that repo. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox`, 2 own commits corrected outdated documentation on subcommand lists, bundled skill counts, and Windows ports, and added notes on remote branch deletion checks. The user also commented on issue #56113 in `anomalyco/opencode`, which reports subagent `model_coming_soon` failures on `MiMo-V2.6-Flash` while the main session works fine; the issue has 6 total comments. No pull requests, reviews, releases, or discussions were recorded that day.
